The patented, flex-activated Rotator Stand System allows the bag’s low-profile base to rest flush against the ground when the strong carbon fiber legs are deployed for exceptional stability. The patented EQ2 Strap features a four-point swivel disc that connects two ergonomically designed straps with the bag, and uses a pivot mechanism that self-adjusts to your gait to automatically trigger a balanced carry experience. Multiple pockets deliver exceptional storage space, including a quick-access magnetic pocket, magnetic rangefinder pocket, hidden valuables pocket and interior lock pocket. The bag has been finished in a soft touch synthetic leather for the best balance of durability and performance, while maintaining an elevated finish. This Player V bag has been built with several unique and special features for Sun Day Red, along with numerous hidden ‘easter eggs’ along the way that nod to Tiger’s incredible journey.
